text:
maya: FYI canary showing webhook signature failures on /hooks/stripe/ vs /hooks/stripe
We normalize paths (strip trailing slash) which breaks the signature calculation for some partners.

sam: Repro'd. stripe sends signature over raw path, they include trailing slash sometimes. Our normalize plugin strips it before auth check.
Log: auth failed: computed_sig!=header (raw_path=/hooks/stripe/ -> normalized=/hooks/stripe)

oliver: Oof. Two quick fixes: 1) run signature verification before normalization, or 2) offer preserve_raw_path flag so verification uses original path. Prefer 1 for safety.

maya: Option 1 needs plugin ordering change. Current runtime runs 'rewrite' stage before 'auth'. Changing order may affect many routes.

lee: Can we make ordering explicit per-route? e.g., stages: [parse, auth, rewrite, proxy] vs [parse, rewrite, auth, proxy]. But that's a surface change.

oliver: Proposed route snippet:
```json
{
  "route": "/hooks/stripe/*",
  "plugins": [
    {"name":"raw_path_preserve","enabled":true},
    {"name":"signature_verifier","stage":"auth"},
    {"name":"normalize_paths","stage":"rewrite","enabled":false}
  ]
}
```

sam: :thumbsup: that keeps normalization but uses raw_path for verifier.

anya: Security note: preserving raw path may allow path smuggling? We should ensure we canonicalize only for routing, not for auth input. Also log when preserve_raw_path is enabled.

maya: Agreed. Also need telemetry: count failures pre/post-change + per-route metric so customers can see impact.

lee: UX question: in console, show plugin pipeline per-route and a small 'runs-before-auth' toggle. Keep default as-is to avoid breaking existing.

oliver: I'll open a PR to runtime with a small change: add optional boolean 'auth_uses_raw_path' at route level. Will include telemetry hooks. Link to RFC soon.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started canary rollout for change-id: rfd-421 (10% traffic) at 2027-05-22T14:12:03Z

maya: Thanks. Monitor stripe webhook errors in datadog dashboard -> webhook.signature.failures
If spike, rollback.

sam: On it. I set an alert at 3x baseline.
